en.title: Choose Android V8 by game requirements
en.body: The arm64 player uses Javet 6.0.4 and V8 15.8.62.52. A game can declare Intl and WebAssembly when selecting its host, and can opt into a compact, signed standalone Release APK.

zh.title: 按游戏依赖选择 Android V8
zh.body: arm64 播放器使用 Javet 6.0.4 和 V8 15.8.62.52，支持按游戏声明的 Intl 和 WebAssembly 选择宿主，并可选择生成更小的独立签名发行 APK。
